keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no row; its Majapahit shape continues through 1478 unsplit). The page names only Trowulan for Kertabhumi ('splitting Majapahit, under Bhre Kertabumi in Trowulan and Singhawikramawardhana in Daha'); the east-Java extent each held is not on the page. The disc is the one the majapahit dossier uses for the contested zone.

region.text: Trowulan, held by the rebel king Kertabhumi (the same disc as the majapahit dossier's contest)

ledger.note: 1468: Kertabhumi rebels and takes Trowulan. 'In 1468 Prince Kertabhumi rebelled against Singhawikramawardhana, promoting himself as the king of Majapahit'; Singhawikramawardhana moved to Daha, so the realm was split between Trowulan and Daha. Kertabhumi allied with Muslim merchants, granting them trading rights on the north coast of Java.

region.text: Trowulan, held by the rebel king Kertabhumi (the same disc as the majapahit dossier's contest)

ledger.note: 1478: Trowulan falls to Daha. 'The year 1478 was the year of Sudarma Wisuta war, when Ranawijaya's army under general Udara ... breached Trowulan defences and killed Kertabumi in his palace.'

region.text: Trowulan, held by the rebel king Kertabhumi (the same disc as the majapahit dossier's contest)

ledger.note: 1478: the rebel Majapahit ends with Kertabhumi's death. The page gives the chronogram 'Sirna ilang kertaning bhumi' (1400 Saka, 1478) for the end of the empire, 'but not the actual fall of Majapahit itself as a whole'; Girindrawardhana ruled from 1474 to 1498.

wars.name: Sudarma Wisuta war

zones.text: Trowulan, held by the rebel king Kertabhumi (the same disc as the majapahit dossier's contest)

wars.outcome: Ranawijaya's army under Udara breached Trowulan and killed Kertabumi in 1478; the realm was split between Trowulan and Daha from 1468.

certainty.note: Only Trowulan is named; the realm's frontiers are not on the page.
